raw_comment: I noticed that there are cases of drought in regions that are typically not associated with hot and dry climates, such as New York. I wonder how these areas can experience drought despite being near abundant water sources. This connects to me and my community because water is essential not only for drinking but also for growing crops that provide our food. Without sufficient water, we could face food shortages and hunger. A headline for this graph could be the negative impact drought has across the U.S.
